description: Recolour the canopy of this tree to rich medium green broad rounded leaves and its trunk to warm natural brown. A plain leafy apple tree between harvests: only green foliage and brown wood. Preserve the exact original silhouette, trunk, branches, root position, pixel grid, 64x80 size and clustered shading. Transparent background. Replace all flower petals or autumn colours with green leaves. No fruit, flowers, ground shadow, text or blur.
